subject: Qualification
notes: kb/Work PB919, wave 57. 8.4.2.2.1 1) 'Qualification of a user-defined name is required unless ... No other name has the identical spelling' - the last name class without it (index-names) now requires qualification exactly when a second visible declaration shares the spelling; a unique index-name (JX in the golden) needs none. Visibility follows 8.4.6.2.3 (an index-name's scope is its table's) and 8.4.6.2.1 3) (a contained program's own declaration wins over a container's GLOBAL one), in IndexNameRegistry.Candidates.
